title: CLI integration and source register
summary: Decision-ready Token Economy concept for versioned coding-agent CLI capability records and a citable evidence register, with live-source conflicts retained explicitly.

implementationTasks.title: CLI domain and capability catalog
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Implement docs/system/domains/cli-integration.md and a versioned src/TokenEconomy/catalog/cli-capabilities.json using this Dossier's schema proposal. Seed Claude Code, Codex CLI, agy, and historical Gemini CLI. Preserve unknowns and evidence scopes; keep model floors separate from successful-version observations. Add schema validation only for fields actually populated. Promote the staged CHANGELOG.proposed.md entry into root CHANGELOG.md under Unreleased as a docs-only entry.

implementationTasks.title: Source register and citation validation
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Implement the source register schema and a stable-id register under src/TokenEconomy/catalog from this Dossier. Require at least one resolvable primary or independent/operator source ID for each catalog fact; record conflicts and supersession; exclude account identifiers. Add CI checks and a 30-day stale flag. Migrate catalog citations incrementally without changing numeric values.

implementationTasks.title: Benchmark and price citation migration
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Backfill source IDs for model-prices.json, benchmark-results.json, benchmark-types.json, routing evidence, and dated snapshots. Preserve legacy source/sourceUrls/sourceUrl/verifiedOn/unconfirmed fields during a compatibility window. Resolve secondary-only benchmark rows with a primary benchmark-operator source or mark unresolved. No score or price changes without a separate evidence review.

implementationTasks.title: Source pages and CLI verification
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Render the source register as a TE docs page and website page in the existing website style. Add a narrow CLI probe protocol for model discovery, effective model identity, permission denials, output events, timeout behavior, and anonymized quota visibility. Capture version, date, auth class, and redacted method; do not record account identifiers. Resolve the agy /usage and timeout documentation conflicts with version-pinned probes.
